normalized_text: – Are you religious? – Yeah – Are you Hindu? – I’m Jain – You are what? – Jain – No no, not your name. India? – Yeah, India – OK. And there’s no God? – No – So, you have a Scripture? – Just given by the Mahavir – So there’s a Scripture he’s given you, right? – Yeah – That Scripture, it doesn’t talk about God? – No – So what does it talk about then? – How to live your life – How to live your life? – Yeah OK. The question I would ask you then, why do we follow him and what he thinks? He is a human being like you and me – I don’t follow him – But his teachings, I mean the book – Yeah – Why? Whatever you find good in your common sense, then just follow it otherwise don’t follow it – But you can do that without anything – So we can do But you call yourself a Jain which means that you ascribe yourself to that specific faith. So I’m saying.. – You understand what I am trying to say, yeah? – I get it I’m from Jain. Currently, I do not believe in any religion. Just still studying OK. We agree on that Now, after that, I’m saying there is multiple evidence for the Big Bang. Some people use the 2nd Law of Thermodynamics Some people use the BMR, radiation that is left over from the Big Bang. Some people use the Red-Shifting, right? So, just to talk about one type of evidence and then to assume that therefore, there is no Big Bang is not quite... It’s disingenuous in a way, right! So, I would personally say this: There is a Big Bang or there isn’t a Big Bang, how did the universe come into existence? Or where did the universe come from? -Still a question that needs to be answered The universe is not a conscious entity that makes and behaves and does actions and does not do actions, Which means they require something conscious with a will to bring it to existence or to organize it in the way it is organized, right? I would say Physics should bring you closer to God than it should bring you further It should bring you closer, because when you see the complexity of the Universe, the speed at which the Universe expands All of these.. like the distance between the Earth and the Sun, the distance between et cetera, so the more knowledge you’ll have.. There is a book called "Six Numbers". It’s very good, very very interesting on this topic – Do you want a copy? – In German Sorry, in German? Yeah, I’ll give you a copy, if you just give me one second, right? – Thank you – No problem. My pleasure – So, coming back.. – What you are trying to say, I’m not getting you Yeah, what I’m trying to say is that the Universe cannot exist without an external entity with a will and power that brings it into existence I’m saying, it just rationally doesn’t make sense, because you would agree with me That in Physics you cannot have something that comes into existence from nothing It’s not possible for something to come from nothing, absolutely nothing So, we say the Universe cannot come from absolute nothingness, the Universe is not a conscious entity, It’s organized in a specific way, it’s restricted in a specific way. It requires an explanation external of itself that restricted it Or made it the way it is, right? So we are saying the Universe is self-evident of the Creator – That’s what we say – Got it So, that’s our position. That’s simple, right? I would say if I believe, for example, You wouldn’t doubt that someone made this phone or this table just by seeing the table, you don’t have to see the maker, right? So we’re saying similarly the Universe is self-evident for the existence of a higher power or something – Yes, I believe in God, but not exactly like everyone is believing – Yeah, we don’t believe God is a man I’ll tell you about the Islamic concept of God. We believe in One Creator You see, that One Creator is not like humans, it’s not a man, it’s not a woman, it’s not a picture We can not conceive and understand God with our limited minds. That’s what we believe as Muslims, right? For example, there is one book also, I think in German only, "The god is dead" – I know you are talking about Nietzsche's.. – So it’s something like.. For example the robots will be ruling over the world in future. For example, robotic.. That’s all assumptions. Two assumptions are there. But I’ll leave.. can tell you two assumptions. The first assumption.. For us.. for the robotic though, a god will be human. And human is not like one man – We don’t believe God is a man – Exactly Yeah, so we are agreeing with you. I’m saying the concept that you believe you will find Islam is close to it, because.. – If you find out, just Google it "Jainism" – Jainism, yeah, OK So there are so many in Canada, Muslims and Jainis are big organisations like a union Most of us, we have only empty rooms. We just pray. There are obviously.. there will be differences between.. But I will tell you something. Look, we said we agree on the idea of God so far. But then comes the idea of religion, right? The reason I follow the Quran -this is why I asked you the question about your Scripture- The reason I follow the Quran is I can prove, or I can establish with evidence that Prophet Muhammadﷺ is a Messenger of God Based on establishing with evidence that Prophet Muhammadﷺ is a Messenger of God, I follow the Quran That’s why I said to you why would I follow the man that you described, right? So, that’s why if the Quran teaches me that this is the Last and Final Messenger, This is the perfect religion I have to follow it because I can establish with evidence that this book is from the Creator, right? – I'll read it – So, give it a read – Pleasure talking to you. Thank you for your time – Try to find Jainism If you have any questions, please come back I’ll have a look definitely. After today, I’ll have a look. I’m usually interested in new things. It’s a good thing, right! – Jainism -it’s very interesting. I’ll have a look. – It’s a very similar history along with Muhammad.. – So it came after Prophet Muhammadﷺ? – Almost the same time – Same time in India. Same time but in India? Started in India? – Yeah, India – OK, no problem. I’ll have a look and research – This is like, the last Prophet I’m talking about is Mahavir OK. I’ll have a look. I'll have a look.. Pleasure talking to you. If you have any questions, come back, yeah! Nice talking to you
